query: What's the process before I finalize my reservation?
answer_markdown: Before finalizing a reservation, VoyageFlow strongly encourages users to verify several details [booking-policies::003]. This includes checking the current price on the partner platform, as VoyageFlow does not display live prices [booking-policies::003]. Users should also confirm the cancellation policy and refund window [booking-policies::003], as well as the room type, bed configuration, and included amenities [booking-policies::003]. It is important to verify the total cost, including taxes, fees, and resort charges [booking-policies::003]. Additionally, users should check passport validity and visa requirements for the destination [booking-policies::003]. VoyageFlow always recommends verifying local health advisories and travel warnings [voyageflow-overview::004]. Users must confirm all pricing, availability, and policies directly with the booking partner before completing payment [booking-policies::002].
